items.text: Archie is on screen.
No one is on screen except: Archie.
Archie is the only person visible in the yard, a single figure.
Archie matches the man in the sprite master (same hair, clothes and build) and looks like the same person as in the S1 wall-lean image.
Archie is standing upright on his own, not leaning against the wall or propped on anything.
Archie's body is turned to face the camera, not in profile or side-on.
Archie stands in roughly the same spot in the yard as in S1, not moved to a new position.
Archie's gaze is aimed at the camera, as if looking the viewer up and down, not off to the side or at the ground.
One of Archie's eyebrows is clearly raised higher than the other.
Archie's mouth shows a faint, closed, unimpressed smile, not a wide grin, a frown or a neutral blank.
A carrier bag is hooked on one of Archie's fingers and hangs from his hand.
The yard background matches the blank plate, with no added, moved or removed objects other than Archie's changed pose.
Archie's face is large and clear enough to read the raised eyebrow and smile.
Camera angle, crop and image size match the blank plate and S1, with Archie fully in frame.
No car appears anywhere in the image.
No buyers or other people appear anywhere in the image, including at the edges or in the background.
No legible text or logos anywhere in the image.
No player face is shown (the player is never seen).
Nothing story-critical sits in the bottom ~10% of the image.
The focal point survives the small-phone crop.
